nodes.title: How to Resample
widgets_values:
1. Load an image (PNG recommended), disable the `Resampler` and 'Run' to get as much of the original image generation details as possible: model, lora, steps, sample, scheduler, seed, positive and negative prompts too. **This is only required if you want the final image saved to have the original metadata: none of the parameters are needed for the resampler. If you skip this step, turn off "save_with_metadata" in the Image Saver.** **Note:** The positive prompt displayed is likely to also include the negative prompt (an issue with the custom node). 2. Enable the Resampler. Doing so will enable ALL the Models, you will need to narrow the list down.
Select the expected model (01a toggles), set the parameters to match the original generation (only enable one model type). 3. Modify the exposed parameters of the Resampler; in particular the `denoise`. 4. Hit `Run` and decide if you like the result or want to try again with different parameters. 5. Use the saved image as the input to the next run to fix another component.
